import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category (scatter plot)
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', 
                          hue='BMI Category', s=80, alpha=0.7, ax=ax1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by BMI Category', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='BMI Category', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9)

# 2. Average Sleep Metrics by Occupation (bar plot)
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
occupation_metrics = df.groupby('Occupation').agg({
    'Sleep Duration': 'mean',
    'Quality of Sleep': 'mean'
}).sort_values('Sleep Duration', ascending=False)
x = np.arange(len(occupation_metrics))
width = 0.35
bars1 = ax2.bar(x - width/2, occupation_metrics['Sleep Duration'], width, 
                label='Sleep Duration', alpha=0.8)
bars2 = ax2.bar(x + width/2, occupation_metrics['Quality of Sleep'], width, 
                label='Quality of Sleep', alpha=0.8)
ax2.set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Average Score', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Average Sleep Metrics by Occupation', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xticks(x)
ax2.set_xticklabels(occupation_metrics.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax2.legend(fontsize=10)

# 3. Distribution of Stress Levels by Sleep Disorder (box plot)
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Sleep Disorder', y='Stress Level', ax=ax3)
ax3.set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Stress Level Distribution by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 4. Correlation Heatmap of Numerical Features
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
numerical_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 
                  'Physical Activity Level', 'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
correlation_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(correlation_matrix, dtype=bool))
sns.heatmap(correlation_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, fmt='.2f', 
            cmap='coolwarm', center=0, square=True, linewidths=1, 
            cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8}, ax=ax4)
ax4.set_title('Correlation Heatmap of Health Metrics', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Physical Activity vs Daily Steps by Gender (scatter with regression)
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Physical Activity Level', y='Daily Steps', 
                          hue='Gender', style='Gender', s=70, alpha=0.7, ax=ax5)
sns.regplot(data=df[df['Gender']=='Male'], x='Physical Activity Level', 
            y='Daily Steps', scatter=False, color='blue', ax=ax5, label='Male Trend')
sns.regplot(data=df[df['Gender']=='Female'], x='Physical Activity Level', 
            y='Daily Steps', scatter=False, color='orange', ax=ax5, label='Female Trend')
ax5.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level (minutes/day)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Physical Activity vs Daily Steps by Gender', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax5.legend(title='Gender', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9)

# 6. Age Distribution by BMI Category (violin plot)
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
sns.violinplot(data=df, x='BMI Category', y='Age', inner='quartile', ax=ax6)
ax6.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Age', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Age Distribution by BMI Category', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
